Name: Randomized Energy
Author: SomeIdiotGames
Description:
One thing that I love about Stardew Valley is the management of time, money, energy, health, and all the sub-systems of the game. The issue that I found was that later in the game the energy sub-system never needed to be managed again because there was so much of it and the tools became easier to use when you level up. This mod, hopefully, changes all of that! This mod will subtract a randomized amount of energy from the player when a Tool is used. The amount of energy consumed will depend on the Tool that is used, and maybe some other secret variables ;].

Early on in the single player game though you might want the ability to regain energy/stamina in bed, so I made this mod as well: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5256/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5256/[/url]
